recipe.name: Susegad Sling
recipe.description: A vibrant, refreshing long drink with bright citrus notes, fragrant herbal aromatics, and a balanced sweet-and-sour profile.
steps: Gently clap or tear one makrut lime leaf and drop it into a cocktail shaker.
Pour in the rum, sweet lime cordial, and fresh lime juice.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously until well-chilled.
Fine strain into a highball glass filled with fresh ice cubes.
Top up with club soda and give a brief, gentle stir to integrate.
Garnish with the second makrut lime leaf.
recipe.garnish: Makrut lime leaf floated on top
recipe.serving: Serve chilled with a glass straw.
